PathOfBuilding.Notes:
Crafting Aura Guy YES i am over capped on block cuz of reduced block mod.
Chest: Fracture 10% mana reservation on a Twilight Regalia. Spam Dense fossils til good energy shield. You can use Augs if you get t1 % and t1 flat. Use eldritch currency for for Int. Craft suppression Ring: Get manifold ring. Spam Spite(int) untl t1 ES , try to get mana also with slams and annuls. Then use crusader exalt with 2 open prefixes to try to hit energy shield. Craft - mana cost
Shield: You recombinate t1 block t1 es and t1 flat es. 2+2=3 means you get t1block and t1 es with t1 block and t1 flat and attempt to make 3 mods (33%) you can use any combination of the 3 as long as it includes all 3. Then use prefixes cannot change and veiled chaos and attempt to unveil a decent mod. Make sure you have 2 open suffix before you proceed. attempt to shapers ex
Helm: Mirrored from echomirrorshop
Shield: You recombinate t1 block t1 es and t1 flat es. 2+2=3 means you get t1block and t1 es with t1 block and t1 flat and attempt to make 3 mods (33%) you can use any combination of the 3 as long as it includes all 3. Then use prefixes cannot change and veiled chaos and attempt to unveil a decent mod. Make sure you have 2 open suffix before you proceed. attempt to shapers exalted orb. If you do not land es on block you have to use prefixes cannot change and reforge es til you hit it. Then 3 craft mod prefixes cannot change veiled exalt and attempt to unveil any INT.
Ring: get manifold ring. Use spite essence til t1 ES with preferebly mana and attempt to crusader slam for energy shield. You have to get a brand new ring everytime. or use any ring with double es and int.
Merc:
The most important stat on watchers is crit reduction and suppression
You can also use another elegant hubris slot like the previous version of the build since you have an open jewel socket.
Crafting: Wand: Fracture Fire flat damage ( using essence is cheaper) . Use loathing (crit) or zeal ( attack speed) until you get the other mod with open suffix. Use suffix cannot change and reforge crit for global crit multiplier. Use wild bristle matron for suffix cannot change and use veiled exalt. Craft increased physical damage to unveil Penetration. Craft spell damage. Wand: mirror from settlers shop.
Shield: Spam any elemental res essence til t1 accuraccy with open suffix. Use suffix cannot change and reforge speed for attack speed. Use wild bristle matron and reforge life til t1 life. Block flat and attempt to slam good mods. Craft fire as extra chaos. I know my shield looks different, it just came out like that.
Gloves: Get life fracture and spam fire res essence til t1 accuracy with open suffix and use suffix cannot change and reforge speed for attack speed. Use wild bristle matron for suffix cannot change and use veiled chaos until projectile speed or aoe. craft the other.
Ring: Get Cogwork ring. Fracture essence reflect mod(insanity) Spam multi essence til andy high elemental resistance( you can change later) with open suffix. Lock your suffixes and used veiled chaos to try to land a suffix. Try to unveil any charges. Endurance will make your guy tankier, Frenzy is good lets you change your chest implicit to something else, if you get power you can replace your boots. All 3 charges are good. Use wild bristle matron and Aug life for decent life and craft elemental damage with attack skills or fire damage to attacks both of them really dont do anything i dont think.
Tailwind boots: any resistance esssence til tailwind. The 3rd suffix doesnt really matter you can get whatever there. If you have open suffix you can try veiled chaos for fire and chaos resistance. Use wild bristle matron for suffix cannot change and use reforge chaos to get hunter mod and use orb of dominance. Craft onslaught.
Body armour. Get grasping mail and fractured overcapped lightning mod. you can also attempt to move the mod from grasping mail to another base by using the attribute essence thats not associated with that base. IE if you use str dex base you use an essence. The first move is not guaranteed but all moves after you cant lose the mod if you isolate 1 suffix each ie 1 overcapped lightning 1 int. You can spam life reforge til you hit t1 life with open prefixes or wtih another prefix you want and use prefixes cannot change veiled chaos and attempt to unveil life. Lock your suffixes and reforge fire til high fire res and craft whatever.
Body armour 2. You can use insanity to get a 3rd mod. Any res or suppression and eldritch currency for t1 life and atttempt to veiled orb. This process is very expensive.
Wand: mirror from settlers shop.
